name: Friction
title: Friction: free After Effects alternative
hook: After Effects charges you twenty three bucks a month to animate your videos. This app does it for free.

features.say: Set keyframes, smooth the motion in a graph, and add effects to your text.
Export animations for the web, or render them straight to video.
Want more? There's an expression editor, and experimental shader effects.

caption:
After Effects charges $22.99/month to animate your videos. Friction does it for free 🎬

✅ Keyframes, a graph editor and text effects
✅ Export animated SVGs for the web, or render MP4 and WebM video
✅ Expression editor and multiple scenes
✅ No subscription, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Friction 1.0 is new and its builds aren't code-signed, so the first launch on Mac or Windows needs an "Open anyway"; shader effects are still experimental. The $22.99/month is Adobe's annual plan, billed monthly
